name: chsrc

patches.old:
download() {
  if command -v curl &>/dev/null; then
    curl -sL "$1" -o "$2"
    return $? # 只能单独 return
  fi

  if command -v wget &>/dev/null; then
    # follow 是wget默认行为
    wget -qO "$2" "$1"
    return $?
  fi

  if is_zh; then
    error_exit "缺乏必要的下载工具(curl或wget)，无法下载文件"
  else
    error_exit "Missing necessary download tools (curl or wget) to download the file!"
  fi
}

patches.new:
chmod +x "$path_to_executable"
    tmp_created_install_dir="" # Preserve successful installation; cleanup remains active for failures.

notes: Converts the official POSIX installer. Uses bytes from the project's official GitHub release for its official Gitee URL alias; version fixed explicitly. The offline smoke lists built-in targets without changing system package sources.
Fixes reproduced upstream EXIT cleanup bug that deleted a newly created successful install directory. Clears only the cleanup marker after chmod succeeds.
